svg.text: E. Fluid manoeuvring (same power as Lead), 60/2 level turn left, wingman on the right

Toy check (scratch script, repo core imported read-only). Lead blue, wingman orange. Controller numbers are estimates. Peak G Lead 2.02, wing 2.75; max G rate Lead 4, wing 4 G/s; max roll rate wing 90 deg/s.
Range, Lead to wingman (ft); green band 500 to 1,000 ft
Angle off Lead’s tail (deg); green band 30 to 60 (sweep)
Ground tracks (north up, scale 206 ft per pixel)
